title: Hat and Scarf Set, Chunky Knit Womens Winter Set, Variegated Blue Purple Brimmed Hat
description:
A matching hat and scarf set in a variegated swirl of blues, purples, and teal — the colors shift as the yarn runs, so the pattern never repeats quite the same way twice. The hat has a wide brim with a cardboard insert tucked inside it, so the brim holds its shape, and the scarf is long enough to wrap twice. Plush, chunky, and warm.

Both pieces were knitted by hand in Michigan in 2024 — the hat on circular needles, the scarf on straight needles. The hat was originally supposed to be a beanie, but it came out oversized and was reworked into a brimmed hat — a happy accident that became part of the design. One of a kind, sold as a set — when it's gone, it's gone.

Size: The hat fits an adult. The scarf measures about 64 inches long by 5 inches wide. The modeled photos show the set worn together.

title: Crochet Poncho, Chunky Marled Black Gray White, Womens Winter Wrap
description:
This crochet poncho is an original piece in chunky marled black, gray, and white.

A chunky crocheted poncho in a black, gray, and white marl — the three colors twist through every stitch, so no two spots look quite the same. A V-neck pullover that drapes over the shoulders and reaches about mid-torso, with the corners draping a bit lower — an easy, warm layer over just about anything.

It was crocheted by hand in Michigan in 2025. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

Crocheted freehand, without a pattern — an original, made once.

Size: One size. Measures about 28 by 32 inches laid flat. The modeled photos show the fit and drape.

One size, fits both adult and child — it just drapes differently depending on your frame: broader shoulders wear it wider, a narrower frame lets it hang longer.

title: Charcoal Knit Hat, Chunky Cold Weather Beanie with Rolled Brim, Teen to Adult
description:
This charcoal knit hat is a chunky loom-knit beanie in soft acrylic — single-layer, with a rolled brim and enough stretch to fit teens through adults. Single-layer — warm without bulk, the everyday hat you grab on the way out the door.

It was loom-knitted by hand in Michigan in 2025. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

Size: Teen to adult. Measures about 9.5 inches laid flat (about 19 inches around, unstretched) and about 8 inches tall. It has stretch, so it fits comfortably. Modeled by a 13-year-old.

The rolled brim sits where you set it — roll it deep for full ear coverage on the coldest days, or shallow for a lighter fit. About 9.5 inches wide laid flat (about 19 inches around) and about 8 inches tall. One of a kind, made once — when it's gone, it's gone.

title: Kids Winter Hat, Color Block Double Layer Knit Hat with Pom Pom, Green Blue Brown
description:
This color block hat was loom-knitted by hand in Michigan — a double-layer kids' hat in green, light blue, and brown with a yellow pom pom.

A color-block winter hat for kids: deep forest green, a soft light-blue stripe, a folded brown brim with a red stripe tucked inside the fold, and a mustard-yellow pom on top. The colors were picked by the maker's wife.

This hat is double-layer all the way through — made that way on purpose, for real warmth. It was loom-knitted by hand in Michigan in November 2025. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

Reversible — turn it inside out for a brown ribbed look with a red stripe, the pom tucked inside. Two hats in one.

Size: Kids' size. Measures about 10 inches laid flat (about 20 inches around, unstretched) and about 11.5 inches tall including the pom (about 9.5 inches without it). It has a little stretch, but not much, so it wears true to the measurement. Modeled by a 13-year-old — it fits her perfectly.

title: Knit Scarf Handmade in Flecked Green, Double-Thick Heathered Sage, 76 Inches Long
description:
Knit scarf handmade in Michigan — flecked green, knit double-thick for real warmth, in a heathered sage tone that goes with everything. The kind of scarf that goes with everything and asks nothing.

This one was originally made by the maker for himself, in the same yarn as our flecked green double-layer hat (listed separately, if it hasn't sold). Made on a circular knitting machine in Michigan in December 2024, and finished by hand. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

Size: About 76 inches long and about 5.25 inches wide, double thickness throughout.

At about 76 inches long and 5.25 inches wide, it wraps twice with room to spare, or hangs long over a coat. The double thickness is the point: two layers of knit hold the warmth in and the wind out, and the flecked yarn hides everyday wear gracefully. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

title: Kids Winter Hat, Flecked Green Double Layer Knit Hat with Charcoal Brim and Pom Pom
description:
This green winter hat is a double-layer knit — two thinner hats combined into one warm one — in flecked green with a charcoal rolled brim and a dark pom pom.

This hat has a story: the yarn was too fine to make a decent hat on its own, so two thinner hats were combined into one double-layer hat. The result is warmer and sturdier than either would have been alone. As the maker says: some of his best pieces are fixes and mistakes, finished right.

Reversible — turn it inside out for a solid charcoal look with a rolled brim. Two hats in one.

Made on a circular knitting machine in Michigan in December 2024, and finished by hand. One of a kind — when it's gone, it's gone.

Size: Kids' size. Measures about 9.5 inches laid flat (about 19 inches around, unstretched) and about 10 inches tall including the pom (about 8.5 inches without it). It has a little stretch, but not much, so it wears close to the measurement. Modeled by a 13-year-old — it fits her perfectly.

title: Twist Ear Warmer in Variegated Teal and Purple, Knit Winter Headband
description:
This knit ear warmer is hand-knitted in variegated teal and purple acrylic with a twist front — stretchy, soft, and warm over the ears.

Hand knitted by Steven at Wolven Fiber Co. in Lansing, Michigan — a twist-front ear warmer in a variegated acrylic that pooled into bold blocks: teal at the sides, a rich purple twist front and center, and a speckled floral panel — pink, white, and green — around the back. Bright, warm, and impossible to duplicate.

Size: about 7.5 inches laid flat (about 15 inches around, unstretched) and about 4.5 inches wide, with plenty of knit give. Plenty of stretch — fits most adults and teens comfortably.

Made with acrylic yarn — easy care, machine washable.

One of a kind and the only one there is. When it's gone, it's gone — the next piece from this den will be something different.

title: Wool Blend Twist Ear Warmer in Red Beacon and Cream, Knit Winter Headband
description:
This knit ear warmer is hand-knitted in Lion Brand Wool-Ease Thick & Quick (80% acrylic, 20% wool) — a twist-front headband in variegated Red Beacon and cream. The variegated Red Beacon yarn pooled as it pleased: a clean cream center carrying the twist, with deep red-and-cream marled ends. No two could ever pool the same way twice.

Size: about 8.5 inches laid flat (about 17 inches around, unstretched) and about 4.5 inches wide, with plenty of knit give. One size fits most adults and teens.

Folded and sewn double-thick most of the way around — extra warmth right over the ears — with the front twist kept single so it sits flat.

Made with Lion Brand Wool-Ease Thick & Quick yarn (80% acrylic, 20% wool) — machine washable and dryable per the yarn label.

One of a kind and the only one there is. When it's gone, it's gone — the next piece from this den will be something different.

title: Chenille Twist Ear Warmer, Knit Winter Headband in Variegated Blue
description:
This knit ear warmer is hand-knitted in plush variegated blue chenille with a twist front — soft, warm, and sized to cover your ears without hat hair. The variegated colors — light blue, navy, taupe, and cream — pool into soft zigzag stripes as it knits up, so the pattern on yours will be one of a kind in the same colors.

The twist sits flat at the front, and the wide band covers your ears fully — all the warmth of a hat without the hat hair.

One size. Measures about 9.5 inches laid flat (about 19 inches around, unstretched) and about 4.75 inches wide. The chenille has very little stretch, so it wears true to the measurement. Modeled by a teen; fits most teens and adults.

Made with Bernat Blanket yarn by Yarnspirations (100% polyester) — machine washable, tumble dry.

Made by hand in Lansing, Michigan. From my den to your home. 🐺
